easy.def: A word for a thing or animal that was just named.
examples: I found my hat. It is red.
The puppy is small, and it is soft.

more.def: A word used instead of the name of a thing, an animal, or an idea that has already been mentioned.
examples: The river was wide, but we crossed it on a bridge.
I lost my notebook, and I cannot find it anywhere.
It is cold and rainy outside today.

easy.def: To have a feeling that makes you want to scratch.

more.def: To make you want to scratch your skin.
examples: The mosquito bite itched all night.
The scratchy tag made my neck itch.
The wool sweater makes me itch.

easy.def: A feeling that makes you want to scratch.

more.def: A feeling on your skin that makes you want to scratch.
examples: I have an itch on my back.
I scratched the itch on my arm.

more.def: Having a feeling on the skin that makes you want to scratch it.
examples: The mosquito bites on my arm were red and itchy.
The wool sweater felt itchy against my neck.
My nose got itchy right before I sneezed.

easy.def: One thing in a list or group.

more.def: A single thing that is part of a list or group.
examples: Write each item on the list.
The last item on the menu is dessert.

more.def: A plan of a trip, with the places you will go and when.
examples: Our itinerary included a stop at the zoo.
Check the itinerary to see when the bus leaves.
The itinerary listed the hotels we would stay in.

more.def: Used when "it" is the one that does something and also gets the action.
examples: The robot vacuum turned itself on.
